content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients have rheumatoid arthritis on record?
I'll check the clinical database for rheumatoid arthritis patients.
This is an OMOP CDM database. I'll count distinct patients with a rheumatoid arthritis condition, using the concept hierarchy to capture RA and its descendants.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS ra_patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 80809
)

content.text: **19,126 patients** have rheumatoid arthritis on record (distinct patients with a condition of RA — concept 80809 — or any of its descendant subtypes in the OMOP database).
